description: This file defines types and functions for matching and resolving nodes based on identifiers, display names, IPs, and client IDs, including scoring and filtering logic.

methods.name: normalizeNodeKey
methods.description: Normalizes a node key string by converting to lowercase, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, and trimming hyphens from ends.

methods.name: resolveNodeMatches
methods.description: Resolves and returns a list of node candidates matching a query string based on scoring.

methods.name: resolveNodeIdFromCandidates
methods.description: Resolves and returns a single node ID from candidates based on a query, handling ambiguities and errors.
